g.text: TrustSwarm serves better answers and calibrated trust

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5e636b

g.text: …but it ranks its own errors worse: AUROC 0.73 vs 0.80–0.87

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5e636b

g.text: Held-out eval (leak-free): 1485 frames, 135 reactions; 200 oracle labels per arm. Whiskers: 95% CI.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5e636b

g.text: AUROC: does the arm's warning score rank its own wrong answers? ECE: calibration of its P(wrong).

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5e636b

g.text: Trusted: share of eval answers the arm serves as trusted.
